# Phase 2A OTLP fixtures

`linked-services.otlp.jsonl` is a real one-line canonical OTLP/JSON request containing linked checkout CLIENT/payment SERVER spans, safe HTTP route templates, an error status, and sensitive unknown attributes that must be discarded. IDs are hexadecimal, enums are numeric, and 64-bit timestamps are decimal strings.

`conflicting-linked-target.otlp.jsonl` isolates a directly linked `payment` server that contradicts `peer.service=wrong-fallback`. The direct target remains authoritative, while confidence is capped at `MEDIUM` and the contradiction is retained as a limitation.

The Phase 2A tests combine these immutable fixtures with canonical OTLP/JSONL snapshots generated by `ptrace.JSONMarshaler`. Every generated snapshot is written to a real file and passed through `prodmap telemetry ingest`; graph scenarios then run the real `prodmap graph` command. This keeps large/cardinality inputs out of Git while exercising linked services, parent/child propagation, producer/consumer `SpanLink` association, contradictory metadata, temporal target resolution, database-only and unresolved-service dependencies, safe and missing endpoints, concrete paths, out-of-order lines/windows, replay and hash conflicts, cycles, missing service identity, outbound spans without a target, redaction, malformed/oversized lines, invalid timestamps, truncation, temporal graph queries, confidence filtering, nearest-rank percentiles, and the invariant that OTel edges are never `EXACT`.
